description: This file defines a service module for managing budgets in a frontend application, including functions to list, create, update, delete budgets, and compute utilization metrics, interfacing with a Supabase backend.

methods.name: listBudgets(userId, month)
methods.description: Fetches a list of budgets for a specific user and optional month, returning an array of budget objects.

methods.name: createBudget(budget)
methods.description: Creates a new budget entry in the database and returns the created object.

methods.name: updateBudget(id, patch)
methods.description: Updates an existing budget identified by its id, applying the specified patch, and returns the updated budget object.

methods.name: deleteBudget(id)
methods.description: Deletes a budget by its id, returning true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: computeUtilization({ userId, month, budgets })
methods.description: Calculates total spent and utilization per budget for a user in a given month.

ctags.name: computeUtilization
ctags.pattern: /^export async function computeUtilization({ userId, month, budgets }) {$/
